foundation_surface_input_group.description: Rate per SF applies to net above-grade foundation wall area from PaintScope. RP rates calibrated from NC sibling with RP-specific adjustments. Base rates for poured concrete, ground access. brush_roll is PRIMARY method.

task_production_rates.name: Landscape Perimeter Protection Setup
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT from NC TSK_FNDN_PROTECT_LANDSCAPE (120 LF/hr). Ground-level task. ~30 sec/LF.

task_production_rates.name: Hardscape Protection Setup
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT from NC TSK_FNDN_PROTECT_HARDSCAPE_WALK (250 SF/hr).

task_production_rates.name: Equipment and Material Staging
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Ground-level equipment staging. Brushes, rollers, trays, materials. 15 min. If spray_backroll: add 10 min for sprayer setup (handled by method-conditional adjustment). Simpler than masonry wall (no scaffold staging).

task_production_rates.name: Visual Condition Inspection

QT3.notes: Full perimeter scan. Document and photograph defects. Assign condition scale.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP-specific assessment. Foundation is small scope — 10-20 min covers full perimeter. Ground-level, no repositioning overhead.

task_production_rates.name: Chalk and Adhesion Test
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: White cloth chalk rub + ASTM D3359 cross-hatch adhesion test. ~10 min for foundation scope. Fewer test points than masonry wall.

task_production_rates.name: Moisture Content Testing (MC <= 4% Hard Stop)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from NC TSK_FNDN_MOISTURE_TEST (20 min). Same duration — foundation MC test is critical in both NC and RP. 3-5 readings per elevation. MC > 4% = HARD STOP.

task_production_rates.name: Grade-Line Gap Assessment (RP-Specific)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP-SPECIFIC. Walk foundation perimeter checking siding-to-foundation gap for incorrect caulking. ~10 min. If caulked: flag for removal (separate scope). Quick visual inspection.

task_production_rates.name: Efflorescence Treatment
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT from NC TSK_FNDN_EFFLORESCENCE_TREAT (200 SF/hr). ~18 sec/SF. Same process in RP — dry brush + TSP wash. Foundation_type modifier (CMU 1.15x slower).

task_production_rates.name: Pressure Wash Foundation Surface

QT2.notes: Basic water wash. Light pressure (1,500 PSI). Remove visible dirt.

QT3.notes: Thorough wash (2,000-2,500 PSI). TSP for stains. Higher pressure on failing areas for paint removal.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from NC TSK_FNDN_PRESSURE_WASH (QT2: 800, QT3: 600). RP rates slightly lower — additional time for paint removal on failing areas. QT2 700 SF/hr, QT3 500 SF/hr. Foundation_type modifier (CMU 1.15x slower). 24-hr dry time before coating.

task_production_rates.name: Scrape and Feather Failing Paint
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP-NEW. Carbide scraper on failing/peeling foundation coating + 80-grit feather sand. ~24 sec/SF. Ground-level, accessible — faster than elevated masonry wall scraping. Rate applies to SF of affected area only. Condition modifier increases total time for POOR condition.

task_production_rates.name: Foundation Crack Patching
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT from NC TSK_FNDN_CRACK_PATCH (75 LF/hr). ~48 sec/LF. Hydraulic cement. Cracks > 1/4 inch = structural, flag for GC.

task_production_rates.name: Prep Dust and Debris Cleanup
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP-NEW. Clean sanding dust, scraping debris, TSP residue from foundation. ~15 min for foundation scope. More debris in RP than NC due to scraping.

task_production_rates.name: Chalk-Binding Primer Application
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP-NEW. Roll application of chalk-binding primer on chalking foundation. ~18 sec/SF. Same rate as NC TSK_FNDN_PRIME_ROLL — primer application is primer application regardless of NC vs RP. Full surface. Foundation_type modifier (CMU 1.15x).

task_production_rates.name: Alkali-Resistant Primer — Spot Application on Bare Masonry
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP-NEW. Spot prime exposed bare foundation at failure points. Slower than full surface prime (150 vs 200 SF/hr) due to spot work targeting scattered areas. Brush or small roller. Rate per SF of spotted area.

task_production_rates.name: Acrylic Stain-Block Primer — Roll Application
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP-NEW. Roll application of acrylic stain-block primer. Same rate as NC roll primer (200 SF/hr). Spot or full prime depending on substrate state. Foundation_type modifier (CMU 1.15x).

task_production_rates.name: Acrylic Stain-Block Primer — Spray Application
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP-NEW. Spray application of acrylic stain-block primer. Slightly slower than NC spray primer (600 SF/hr) due to spot work around patched areas. 550 SF/hr. spray_backroll method.

task_production_rates.name: Acrylic Finish — Roll Application
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT from NC TSK_FNDN_FINISH_ACRYLIC_ROLL (200 SF/hr). Same product on primed surface. Per-coat rate. Foundation_type modifier (CMU 1.15x).

task_production_rates.name: Acrylic Finish — Spray Application
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from NC TSK_FNDN_FINISH_ACRYLIC_SPRAY (650 SF/hr). Slightly slower in RP (600 SF/hr) — more careful around patched areas and transitions. spray_backroll method. Per-coat rate.

task_production_rates.name: Cementitious Coating (Drylok-type) — Roll Application
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT from NC TSK_FNDN_FINISH_CEMENTITIOUS_ROLL (140 SF/hr). Same heavy-body material. Per-coat rate. Foundation_type modifier (CMU 1.15x).

task_production_rates.name: Cementitious Coating (Drylok-type) — Brush Application
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT from NC TSK_FNDN_FINISH_CEMENTITIOUS_BRUSH (75 SF/hr). Detail brush work. Per-coat rate.

task_production_rates.name: Detail Brush Work (Pipes, Vents, Transitions)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT from NC TSK_FNDN_FINISH_BRUSH_DETAIL (65 SF/hr). ~55 sec/SF. MASK grade-line gap — NEVER caulk. Per-coat rate.

task_production_rates.name: Backroll After Spray (CMU Foundation)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP-NEW. Immediate backroll after spray on CMU. 400 SF/hr — follows spray operator. 18-inch roller forces coating into porous block surface. Per masonry doctrine, CMU requires backroll. Poured concrete does NOT require backroll. Per-coat rate.

task_production_rates.name: Final Walkthrough Inspection
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT from NC TSK_FNDN_FINAL_INSPECT (20 min). Ground-level walkthrough. Check holidays, uniformity, grade-line gap clear.

task_production_rates.name: Touch-Up
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT from NC TSK_FNDN_TOUCHUP (75 SF/hr). Brush touch-up per SF of touched-up area.

task_production_rates.name: Protection Material Removal
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT from NC TSK_FNDN_PROTECT_TEARDOWN (20 min). Remove tarps, covers, tape. Small scope.

task_production_rates.name: Tool and Equipment Cleaning
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT from NC TSK_FNDN_TOOL_CLEAN (18 min). Clean brushes, rollers, trays, sprayer if used.

task_production_rates.name: Site Debris Cleanup
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP-NEW. Collect scraping debris, paint chips, empty containers. ~15 min for foundation scope. More debris in RP than NC.

task_production_rates.name: Customer Walkthrough
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP-NEW. Walk foundation perimeter with homeowner/GC. ~10 min. Occupied home context. Discuss maintenance, point out completed work.

factor_modifiers.name: Foundation Substrate Type Modifier
factor_modifiers.description: Foundation type affects production rate. Poured concrete is baseline (smooth, dense). CMU is slower due to porous surface and irregular geometry.
factor_modifiers.notes: Inherited from NC. Poured concrete baseline, CMU 15% slower. Applied to prep and coating tasks.

factor_modifiers.name: Condition Scale Prep Modifier
factor_modifiers.description: Condition scale drives prep task intensity. Foundation modifiers are lower than masonry wall due to ground-level access and simpler geometry.
factor_modifiers.notes: RP-SPECIFIC. Prep tasks only — coating tasks unaffected by condition (once prepped, surface is at baseline). Foundation modifiers lower than masonry wall (1.0/1.3/1.6 vs 1.0/1.5/2.0).

quality_effects.notes: Economy tier. Single finish coat. SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT may skip prime entirely. Block filler N/A in RP.
Standard tier. Two finish coats. No interstage sanding (utilitarian surface). Foundation does not warrant interstage cycle even at QT3.

modifier_stacking_examples.scenario: Poured concrete, acrylic, GOOD condition, brush_roll (QT3)
modifier_stacking_examples.notes: Best case — smooth poured concrete, sound paint, roll. 200 SF/hr.
Worst-case prep — CMU in poor condition. 272 SF/hr for pressure wash. Well under 4.0x cap.
Slowest finish — cementitious on CMU. 122 SF/hr. Maximum coating modifier is 1.15x.

max_modifier_stack.prep_worst_case: FAC_FNRP_CONDITION(1.60) x FAC_FNRP_FOUNDATION_TYPE(1.15) = 1.84x — well under 4.0x cap
max_modifier_stack.notes: Simplest modifier profile of any exterior RP spec. Only 2 modifiers. No access modifier (ground-level). No RRP. No coating system modifier. Max stack 1.84x.

assumptions.value: Ground-level access for all tasks. No height modifier.
assumptions.source: Inherited from NC spec. Foundation band is at grade.

assumptions.value: RRP excluded. Foundation coating is modern practice.
assumptions.note: If lead paint suspected, refer to specialist.

assumptions.value: Block filler excluded from RP — already applied during NC.

risks.description: Condition scale modifiers (1.0/1.3/1.6) are engineering estimates, not field-calibrated for foundation RP. May need adjustment after first RP foundation projects.
risks.mitigation: Flag for field calibration. Compare actual vs estimated on first 3 foundation RP projects.

risks.description: Excluding RRP may miss edge case of pre-1978 painted foundation (e.g., industrial buildings converted to residential).
risks.mitigation: If lead paint suspected on foundation, refer to lead specialist. Document in SOP that foundation RP does not include RRP.

validation_plan.description: Time a standard foundation repaint project (200 LF perimeter, 24-inch band, ~400 SF) from setup to cleanup.
validation_plan.expected_range: 5-10 hours total (QT3, brush_roll, poured concrete, acrylic, FAIR condition, 2 finish coats).
validation_plan.calibrates: All task rates and overall project duration.

validation_plan.description: Compare GOOD vs FAIR vs POOR condition foundation RP production.
validation_plan.expected_range: FAIR should be 20-30% longer than GOOD. POOR should be 50-60% longer than GOOD on prep tasks.
